gloss: rear; end of the line; tail end

definitions.gloss: the very end of a line or queue; the rear; the tail end
definitions.explanation: Refers to the last position in a line, queue, or procession. Extremely common in everyday situations involving waiting in line.

examples.japanese: {最後尾|さいこうび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧です。
examples.english: The end of the line is over here.

examples.japanese: {最後尾|さいこうび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please line up at the back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最後尾|さいこうび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧プラカード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧「⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{最後尾|さいこうび}です」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{示|しめ}していた→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: The person at the end of the line was holding a sign saying 'End of line here.'

notes:
A very practical word you'll encounter frequently at popular restaurants, events, theme parks, and train stations in Japan. Staff or the last person in line often holds a sign reading {最後尾|さいこうび} so newcomers know where to join.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最後尾|さいこうび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up at the back
- {最後尾|さいこうび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧: "end of line" sign
- {最後尾|さいこうび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧: the end of the line is here

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧: last (general, not specific to queues)
- ⟦{末尾|まつび}→末尾：13065_matsubi⟧: end, tail (more literary; used for lists or documents)
- ⟦{先頭|せんとう}→先頭：04374_sentou⟧: the front, the head of the line (antonym)
